title: pennsylvania-lpm Curriculum Crosswalk Record
description: A pointer from an official Pennsylvania content standard (a biological-evolution benchmark in the state's own Academic Standards for Science and Technology) to machine-readable curriculum-graph data that already exists elsewhere in this ecosystem -- ConceptBase/CompetencyBase records, bio-core-k12/interdisciplinary-k12 LPM strands, or this repo's own case/ CASE-format files. This is deliberately NOT a document archive and NOT a re-implementation of PDE's own standards documents: state/pennsylvania/lp/ holds metadata ABOUT how far a crosswalk has progressed, not the standards content itself. Modeled on deutsche_lp's/nys_lp's/florida-lpm's curriculum-crosswalk-record.schema.json; sourceSystem adds 'case-network-conformant-publisher' and 'common-standards-project-api', same as florida-lpm, since this repo's own machine-readable-standards research checked the same two leads for Pennsylvania -- see docs/source-notes/.

standardOrAttribute.description: What this crosswalk covers, e.g. 'Pennsylvania Academic Standards for Science and Technology, Biological Sciences -- Evolution benchmarks'. A crosswalk record is scoped to one standard set or benchmark cluster.

sourceSystem.description: 'openevo-conceptbase-competencybase-informal-refs' = this ecosystem's own ConceptBase/CompetencyBase records, loosely referenced (informal fields, not yet validated cross-repo links -- see CONTRIBUTING.md). 'ngss-nyssls-published-standards-doc' = the official published standards document itself (PDF/web page), not a live queryable API -- reused here for PDE's own PDF/web-published standards. 'case-network-conformant-publisher' = a real, externally-hosted 1EdTech CASE Network API endpoint for this standard set. 'common-standards-project-api' = the free, public Common Standards Project REST API (api.commonstandardsproject.com) -- confirmed live for florida-lpm's standards; see docs/source-notes/ for whether it also covers Pennsylvania. 'openevo-graph-case-format-local-file' = this repo's own CASE-format (openevo-graph/schema/case_schema.json) CFDocument/CFItem JSON file under case/. 'not-yet-available' = no machine-readable crosswalk exists yet for this standard/attribute.

sourceRepoPath.description: Relative path to the actual data file in a sibling repo (e.g. '../../../bio-core-k12/strands/strand-102-natural-selection-adaptation.yaml' or '../../../competencybase/records/...'). This repo references that file; it does not copy its contents in.

coverageStatus.description: How far the referenced data has progressed, mirroring deutsche_lp's own three-tier progression convention.

licenseOrRightsNote.description: The legal/rights status of the referenced external dataset itself (not this record, which stores no source text). Mirrors OpenLPM's standards_documents.license_or_rights_note field (openlpm migration 019) for ecosystem-wide naming consistency. accessTier does not apply to this schema since it deliberately stores no excerpt/full text -- see this schema's own description.
